Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939)
Thanks for repairing the omission. I believe ladies always enjoy gentlemen doing what they are so apt to do themselves.[^1]
I enclose my [brother](../persons.html#1624)s biscuits, much hoping they may answer the purpose.[^2]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: He had sent her an unsigned cheque.

[^2]: JBY wanted to publish an article on the Huntley and Palmer biscuit factory at Reading in Macmillan\'s Magazine.
